## Endorsements
## Leaders Supporting Shannon for Congress
As Henrico’s top prosecutor, Shannon Taylor has delivered justice with integrity, independence, and a deep commitment to the people she serves. For more than a decade, she has worked to keep families safe — prosecuting violent offenders, protecting victims, and standing firm against those who would do her community harm. Now she’s ready to take that same fight to Washington. I’ve known Shannon for years, I’ve seen her work up close, and I know she will fight tirelessly for the hardworking families of Virginia’s 1st District. I am proud to endorse her campaign and to partner with her to deliver for Virginia.
# Abigail Spanberger
As Henrico’s top prosecutor, Shannon Taylor has dedicated herself to delivering justice without fear or favor. Since 2012, Shannon has worked to keep the residents of Henrico safe by prosecuting murderers, drug dealers, and fraudsters, and standing up for victims and their families. Now she is running to stand up for hardworking families in Virginia’s 1st District. As a friend of Shannon’s for more than 15 years, I’m proud to endorse her as she runs to serve as an independent leader in Congress for her community.
# Tim Kaine
## U.S. Senator
Shannon Taylor has dedicated her life to protecting Virginians, and that’s exactly why I am proud to endorse her campaign for Congress. As Henrico’s top prosecutor, Shannon took on tough fights in the courtroom to keep our communities safe, and I know she will take the fight to Congress to protect our health care and make life more affordable for working families. She is the strongest candidate to prosecute the case against Rob Wittman and give Virginians a representative who will actually fight for us.
# Ralph Northam
## Former Governor of Virginia
Shannon Taylor has spent her career prosecuting criminals, protecting families, and standing up to the most powerful special interests on behalf of everyday people.
In Congress, she will bring the same courage, integrity and independence in delivering for the people of Virginia’s First District. Shannon is exactly the kind of leader we need to hold Washington accountable.
# Don Beyer
## U.S. Congressman
Shannon Taylor has dedicated her life to public service and protecting Virginians. As commonwealth’s attorney, she’s taken on extremists, held violent criminals accountable, and delivered real results for her community. Shannon will bring this same toughness and integrity to Congress to fight for Virginians and their families. I’m proud to endorse my friend Shannon as the next representative for Virginia’s 1st Congressional District.
# Mark Herring
